# VENDOR-023 — Qualcomm Hexagon NPU for Agentic AI

## 30-second read
Qualcomm publicly says Agentic mobile workloads motivate:
- a transformer-focused Element Accelerator;
- scalar/vector/matrix extensions;
- 50% larger NPU shared memory;
- persistent/multimodal/long-context/concurrent-Agent execution;
- CPU orchestration that keeps data ready for the NPU.

This is a strong mobile product-direction signal, but all performance/value numbers are vendor claims.

See deep.md.
